elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to each Party's aggregate liability)
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: First cap limb: fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "the amounts paid or payable between the Parties under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — 'amounts' rather than fees, and anchored to the event, not the claim

elements.element: Second cap limb: USD 1,000,000, expressed as the greater of the two limbs

elements.evidence: "NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "'Excluded Claims' means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection obligations
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Amounts owed by Kubient to Customer under Section 5 are not damages for purposes of this cap." — addresses Vendor-to-Customer payments, not Customer's payment obligations
cap is "the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable ... and (b) USD 1,000,000" — an 'amounts' basis plus a preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor, not a 12 months' fees cap

reasons: The fee limb of the cap uses "the amounts paid or payable between the Parties" and is anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim"; the preferred position requires 'fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim'. Replace 'amounts ... between the Parties' with 'fees paid or payable' and 'the event giving rise to the claim' with 'the claim'.

The payment-obligations sentence runs the wrong direction: it protects amounts owed by Kubient to Customer under Section 5 rather than stating that Customer's payment obligations (or all amounts due under the Agreement) are not damages for cap purposes.

Fallback is likewise not met on its own terms: the cap is a greater-of construct including the preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor and is measured on 'amounts' rather than 12 months' fees, so the two bargains cannot be blended.

Carve-out set is complete and mutual (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), and the insertion is a concise new sub-clause that leaves Section 7(a) and all other terms intact.
